Identity-agnostic shortest path 宮村 → 天橋立 (4539.254 m) passes the vertex with an incoming from-identity edge and outgoing to-identity edge. Geometry details: geometry.json.
junctions.temporalEvidence: Opening of 宮福線, not the 2015-04-01 WILLER operator start. On the KTR history page, under the heading 宮福線の経緯・沿革, the 1988 row is 1月27日 レール締結式 and 7月16日 開業. The same page defines 宮福線 as 福知山–宮津, and records service at 宮津 from 1924-04-12 (峰山線 舞鶴・宮津) with the name 宮津線 from 1932-08-10. Successor chain on that page: 宮福鉄道 opened the line, renamed 北近畿タンゴ鉄道 on 1989-08-01, and WILLER TRAINS is the second-category operator. This dates the 宮津 connection of those two lines, not every current surveyed vertex.
